all_feature_defaults.grouping: Organization-local User or IP key; identifiers are grouping keys only
all_feature_defaults.availability: Only complete timestamp batches at or before scoring time t; seven-day structural retention and ten-minute recency enforced by accepted runtime
all_feature_defaults.missing: No missing outcomes accepted; active nodes have nonzero retained attempts; absent recent counts are zero; orphan nodes omitted
all_feature_defaults.inference_justification: All values derive from observed local login timestamps, outcomes and local User-IP interactions; no future or evaluator information required

forbidden: Deny all unlisted feature columns, labels, masks, campaign/credential IDs, source flags, raw local keys, ingestion tokens and future aggregates
layer_blocks: Each layer packet has only x, edge_index, num_nodes. Destination-prefix counts and private mappings are separate routing metadata; root labels/masks are separate supervision. Later GraphSAGE uses source hidden states and destination prefix, never private identifiers.
